summary: Configured Asterisk PBX with the AudioSocket module and wrote a Python WebSocket client bridging live calls to the Desible AI voice engine, enabling real-time AI handling of answered outbound calls. Deployed on AWS EC2 with SIP trunk origination.

Built a document indexing and search portal supporting text and real-time voice queries over large repositories. Integrated OpenAI for NLU and Whisper for speech-to-text with document-grounded conversational responses. Deployed on Hetzner Cloud.

Configured Asterisk and Kamailio across two Ubuntu servers with a custom admin panel for extension provisioning, call routing and tenant management. Designed multilingual IVR with language detection and prompt playback.

Delivered Asterisk PBX from scratch on hosted hardware: softphone login, inbound/outbound calling, voicemail, IVR and SIP trunk integration. Wrote Bash automation and Python AGI programs for dynamic routing, plus an admin panel.

Command-based programming, testing and troubleshooting of GTD 5 and DMS 100 telephony switches. Resolved SIP/ISUP call and trunking faults via call tracing and pcap analysis using IRIS, CGIS and Wireshark. Owned incident lifecycle, escalation and RCA.
Hardware and software support for consumer and enterprise customers. Full remote diagnosis via Rescue, TeamViewer and AnyDesk. Case logging and escalation in SAP and MSD.
